item.title: github: Purpose-built model for leaked secret detection
item.description:
GitHub announced a new purpose-built, context-aware model for leaked secret detection as part of Secret Protection. It is intended to improve secret detection in code workflows, including those that involve AI agents.

  • Source: GitHub

item.title: github: GitHub Advanced Security expands trial availability
item.description:
GitHub Advanced Security self-serve trials are now available to more GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers. The trial can be used to evaluate GitHub Code Security and GitHub Secret Protection.

  • Source: GitHub
